source_reference_resolution.note: Legacy executable scripts were removed at user request. Original path:line references below resolve through these preserved run snapshots; line numbers refer to the historical source.

scope: Source review of the causal benchmark pipeline, LINK prompt search, graph ranking and NOUL safety sweep; not an independent audit of all historical model calls.

findings.issue: Trajectory safety labels are compared to maximum pre-action scores without action-level observability annotations.
findings.consequence: Cannot separate prediction errors from disagreement between the evaluation target and available evidence.
findings.resolution: Separate pre-action safety and retrospective trajectory classification; annotate when a violation is observable.

findings.issue: Repeatedly inspected ATBench examples and synthetic test outputs influenced later experimental decisions.
findings.consequence: Existing results are exploratory; within-run Holm does not account for the entire adaptive research history.
findings.resolution: Exposure ledger and a genuinely locked, scenario-group-disjoint confirmation set.

findings.issue: No independent naturalistic dependency graph gold; old audit has 29 definite pairs and six positives.
findings.resolution: Independent annotation with adjudication and explicit unknown/ambiguous labels.

findings.issue: Synthetic provenance is assigned by generator logic; repeated contents and unspecified directive scope can admit other interpretations.
findings.resolution: Audit label identifiability from visible evidence, not only causal validity of edge indices.

findings.issue: No independently verified-graph SAFETY condition isolates graph construction from graph consumption.
findings.resolution: Run verified graph, same highlighted facts without edges, and controlled corruption before further LINK search.

findings.issue: Fixed density target is not length-invariant; sparse fixed-indegree graphs have density approximately 2k/(n-1).
findings.resolution: Report degree, false/missing edges, graph size ratios and length strata; do not force density.

findings.issue: Random graph at LINK 0.418895 shares 268/376 edges with inferred graph.
findings.resolution: Record effective corruption; restrict structural contrasts to cases permitting alternatives and report coverage.

findings.issue: Identical class decisions do not imply no graph sensitivity: 119/421 action scores differ for graph versus random at the best-F1 LINK threshold in each presentation.
findings.resolution: Report scores, decisions and effect intervals separately; equivalence requires a prespecified margin.

findings.issue: Sweep patches another executable module's functions, constants and sys.argv.
findings.resolution: Explicit package functions and configuration; archival scripts remain immutable evidence.

findings.issue: New plan retains obsolete 20/80 density calibration rule; dtype fields conflate checkpoint and runtime precision.
findings.resolution: Independent schemas for protocol, checkpoint metadata and observed runtime.

findings.issue: Rounded versus native scores, differing undefined-precision rules and graph-specific field names in SAFETY reports.
findings.resolution: Metrics v2 with native scores, explicit undefined values and domain-neutral field names; retain v1 results unchanged.

findings.issue: Three long excluded cases are unsafe; successful-case metrics do not measure total-system coverage or safety.
findings.resolution: Report exclusions by label and length and predefined abstention behavior; never relabel rejections as safe.

findings.issue: Dependence across benchmark source templates and sensitivity to runtime/call ordering have not been fully quantified.
findings.resolution: Inspect source-group duplicates and perform a small matched runtime repeat before any confirmatory inference.

strengths: Saved raw requests, encodings and pointer scores
Labels and rationale excluded from model inputs
unsupported_conclusions: The short prompt is universally best
